hook.text_top: He just found out he can fly.
hook.text_bottom: Wait till he takes off over the city...
hook.voice: He just found out he can fly.

intro_voice: Here's the original, made with Seedance 2.5.

shots.excerpt: Medium close from the front, framed on his chest: he holds both hands up palms-up, fingers curling and trembling; blurred golden lot behind.
shots.voice: Shot 2. Just his hands, trembling. The story starts before anything happens.

shots.excerpt: Locked-off wide, low: two scorched footprints burned into the concrete in the foreground, glowing orange embers and black soot, smoking.
shots.voice: Shot 6. The speed is shown by what he leaves behind: two burning footprints in the concrete.

shots.excerpt: Low-angle shot in the middle of the city street: he lands in a three-point crouch; the asphalt cracks and a dark crater of dust bursts out; cars brake hard.
shots.voice: Shot 10. A low angle and a three-point landing. The cracked asphalt sells the weight.

shots.excerpt: Close-up tracking with him as he runs: face sharp, jaw clenched, background streaking in strong horizontal motion blur, slight handheld shake.
shots.voice: Shot 15. His face stays sharp while the city smears behind him. That is how speed reads on screen.

shots.excerpt: He springs up off the road; the camera tilts and cranes up with him past a dark glass tower, clears the rooftops; he shrinks to a silhouette against the golden sky.
highlight: tilts and cranes up with him
shots.voice: Shot 19. The camera cranes up with him until he is a speck against the sunset.
